name: Forced Subtitles (Whisper)
description: Translates only the foreign-language lines of a movie into a forced English subtitle, using a local Whisper service.
overview: Forced English subtitles for foreign dialogue, generated locally with Whisper

versions.changelog:
Forced Subtitles plugin for Jellyfin 12.4

Jellyfin plugin plus a local faster-whisper service that finds foreign-language
lines in a movie, translates them to English, and writes Movie.en.forced.srt.
Includes a plugin repository manifest and GitHub Actions release workflow.
